reason: The hard_v5 V5 lockstep bench fixes the argmax edges: out_v/out_flit are flop Q (u_data pin register), fault is u_chk's sticky flop, and u_chk sees every input through one RTL pin flop (arg fault +1, documented ABI); u_data's live inputs feed only the amerge stage-1 flops (key/index/valid) and rank. A synthesis pin stage would shift out_v/out_flit off the static schedule.
